# Abilities

<!-- Generated by `rake docs` from the primitive registry. Do not edit. -->

## activated

An activated ability: announce it, choose targets, pay its costs, then it goes on the stack. `timing: "sorcery"` restricts it to sorcery speed.

Rules: CR 602.1, CR 602.2, CR 602.5d

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `cost` | list of costs (tap, {"mana": "{1}"}, {"mana": "{X}"}) |
| `targets` | list of target filters |
| `effects` | list of effects |
| `timing` | "instant" (default) or "sorcery" |
| `cost_reduction` | {"amount": amount, "if": condition}: "this ability costs {N} less to activate" (CR 601.2f, 602.2b) |

```json
{
  "activated": {
    "cost": [
      "tap"
    ],
    "targets": [
      "any_target"
    ],
    "effects": [
      {
        "deal_damage": {
          "amount": 1,
          "to": {
            "target": 0
          }
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## cant_be_blocked_by

This creature can't be blocked by creatures matching `filter` (checked as blockers are declared, with their current characteristics).

Rules: CR 509.1b, CR 509.1a

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `filter` | a creature filter, e.g. {"creature": {"power": {"at_most": 2}}} |

```json
{
  "cant_be_blocked_by": {
    "filter": {
      "creature": {
        "power": {
          "at_most": 2
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## cant_be_targeted_by

This permanent can't be the target of abilities its controller's opponents control whose source matches `abilities_from` (a card spec, e.g. {"types": ["artifact"]}).

Rules: CR 115.4, CR 113.7, CR 702.11d

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `abilities_from` | card spec of the ability's source |

```json
{
  "cant_be_targeted_by": {
    "abilities_from": {
      "types": [
        "artifact"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

## chapter

A Saga's chapter ability: triggers when lore counters put on it bring their number from below `chapter` to at least `chapter`. Its targets are chosen as it's put on the stack. A Saga's final chapter number is its greatest `chapter`.

Rules: CR 715.2, CR 715.2b, CR 715.2c, CR 715.2d, CR 122.6

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `chapter` | integer >= 1 (the chapter symbol's number) |
| `targets` | list of target filters |
| `effects` | list of effects |
| `modes` | optional modes, as for a spell |

```json
{
  "chapter": {
    "chapter": 2,
    "effects": [
      {
        "gain_life": {
          "amount": 3
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## cost_modifier

While on the battlefield: spells cast by `caster` (you, opponent or any; default you) whose card types match `spells` ({"any_of": [types], "not": [types]}, default all spells) cost `reduce` less or `increase` more generic mana.

Rules: CR 601.2f, CR 118.7a, CR 604.1

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `spells` | {"any_of": [types], "not": [types]} (optional) |
| `caster` | you | opponent | any |
| `reduce` | amount |
| `increase` | amount |

```json
{
  "cost_modifier": {
    "spells": {
      "not": [
        "creature"
      ]
    },
    "reduce": 1
  }
}
```

## cost_reduction

This spell costs `amount` generic mana less to cast, if the optional `if` condition holds when its total cost is determined (after targets are chosen). `amount` may be computed, e.g. {"count": {"each": "artifact", "controller": "you"}} for affinity for artifacts (CR 702.41a). It can't reduce colored mana or go below {0}.

Rules: CR 601.2f, CR 118.7a, CR 702.41a

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `amount` | amount (integer or computed) |
| `if` | condition (optional) |

```json
{
  "cost_reduction": {
    "amount": 1,
    "if": {
      "attacked": true
    }
  }
}
```

## cycling

Cycling: pay `cost` and discard this card from your hand to draw a card. With `for` it is typecycling: instead search your library for a card matching `for`, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.

Rules: CR 702.29a, CR 702.29b, CR 702.29e, CR 702.29f, CR 113.6m, CR 602.2a

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `cost` | mana cost string, e.g. "{2}" |
| `for` | optional card spec for typecycling (see search_library) |

```json
{
  "cycling": {
    "cost": "{2}",
    "for": {
      "supertypes": [
        "basic"
      ],
      "types": [
        "land"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

## destroy_replacement

If a permanent matching `affects` would be destroyed (by an effect, lethal damage or deathtouch), instead: all its `remove_counters` counters are removed (if given) and, with `remove_damage: true`, all damage marked on it is removed. Sacrificing isn't destroying, and 0 toughness isn't either.

Rules: CR 614.1a, CR 614.8, CR 701.8a, CR 701.21a, CR 704.5f, CR 704.5g, CR 704.5h

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `affects` | {"each": filter, "controller": ..., "other": bool} |
| `remove_counters` | counter name |
| `remove_damage` | boolean |

```json
{
  "destroy_replacement": {
    "affects": {
      "each": {
        "creature": {
          "counters": "+1/+1"
        }
      },
      "controller": "you",
      "other": true
    },
    "remove_counters": "+1/+1",
    "remove_damage": true
  }
}
```

## double_counters

While this permanent is on the battlefield, if its controller would put one or more counters (only `counter`, if given) on a permanent matching `affects` ({"each": filter, "controller": you|opponent|any}, relative to this permanent's controller), the number put is doubled. This includes counters a permanent enters with.

Rules: CR 614.1a, CR 122.6, CR 122.6a, CR 616.1

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `affects` | {"each": filter, "controller": ...} |
| `counter` | optional counter name |

```json
{
  "double_counters": {
    "affects": {
      "each": "creature",
      "controller": "you"
    }
  }
}
```

## draw_replacement

While this permanent is on the battlefield, each time its controller would draw a card, they draw `amount` cards instead (even with an empty library). The draws it makes aren't replaced by it again, but another such effect applies to each of them.

Rules: CR 614.11, CR 614.11a, CR 614.5, CR 121.2, CR 616.1

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `amount` | integer >= 2 |

```json
{
  "draw_replacement": {
    "amount": 2
  }
}
```

## enchant

The Aura's enchant ability: a target filter for what its spell targets and what the Aura may be attached to, e.g. "creature" or {"permanent": {"any_of": ["artifact", "creature"]}}. Only Auras have it.

Rules: CR 702.5a, CR 115.1b, CR 303.4a

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `(value)` | a target filter for a permanent |

```json
{
  "enchant": "creature"
}
```

## enters_attacking

While this permanent's controller controls an attacking creature, permanents matching `affects` enter the battlefield tapped and attacking (the defending player). They never "attacked", so attack triggers don't see them.

Rules: CR 614.1c, CR 508.4, CR 506.4

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `affects` | {"each": filter, "controller": you|opponent|any} |

```json
{
  "enters_attacking": {
    "affects": {
      "each": "creature",
      "controller": "you"
    }
  }
}
```

## enters_tapped

This permanent enters the battlefield tapped (a self-replacement effect).

Rules: CR 614.1c, CR 614.12

```json
"enters_tapped"
```

## enters_tapped_unless_pay_life

As this permanent enters, its controller may pay `life` life; if they don't, it enters tapped. You can't pay more life than you have.

Rules: CR 614.12, CR 119.4

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `life` | integer |

```json
{
  "enters_tapped_unless_pay_life": {
    "life": 2
  }
}
```

## enters_untapped

Permanents matching `affects` enter the battlefield untapped, even if another effect or their own ability would have them enter tapped.

Rules: CR 614.1c, CR 614.12, CR 616.1

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `affects` | {"each": filter, "controller": you|opponent|any} |

```json
{
  "enters_untapped": {
    "affects": {
      "each": "land",
      "controller": "you"
    }
  }
}
```

## enters_with_counters

Without `affects`: this permanent enters with the `counters` on it. With `affects` ({"each": filter, "controller": you|opponent|any, "other": true}, relative to this permanent's controller): while this permanent is on the battlefield, each matching permanent enters with the `counters` in addition to any others.

Rules: CR 614.1c, CR 614.12, CR 122.6, CR 122.6a

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `counters` | {counter name: n} (n >= 1) |
| `affects` | optional {"each": filter, "controller": ..., "other": bool} |

```json
{
  "enters_with_counters": {
    "counters": {
      "+1/+1": 1
    },
    "affects": {
      "each": "creature",
      "controller": "you",
      "other": true
    }
  }
}
```

## equip

Equip: pay `cost` to attach this Equipment to target creature you control (not itself). Sorcery speed. Only Equipment have it.

Rules: CR 702.6a, CR 301.5b, CR 301.5c, CR 701.3a

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `cost` | list of costs, e.g. [{"mana": "{2}"}] |

```json
{
  "equip": {
    "cost": [
      {
        "mana": "{2}"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## loyalty

A loyalty ability. Its cost adds (positive) or removes (negative) loyalty counters and is paid on activation. Sorcery speed, and only one loyalty ability per planeswalker per turn.

Rules: CR 606.3, CR 606.4, CR 606.5, CR 602.2b

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `cost` | integer, e.g. 1 for +1 or -2 |
| `targets` | list of target filters |
| `effects` | list of effects |

```json
{
  "loyalty": {
    "cost": -3,
    "targets": [
      "creature"
    ],
    "effects": [
      {
        "deal_damage": {
          "amount": 3,
          "to": {
            "target": 0
          }
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## mana

An activated mana ability: pay the cost, add the mana to your mana pool immediately. It does not use the stack and can be activated whenever you have priority.

Rules: CR 605.1a, CR 605.3a, CR 605.3b, CR 106.4

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `cost` | list of costs (e.g. ["tap"]) |
| `produce` | mana symbols added, e.g. "{G}" or "{C}{C}" |

```json
{
  "mana": {
    "cost": [
      "tap"
    ],
    "produce": "{C}"
  }
}
```

## player_rule

While this permanent is on the battlefield, `rule` applies to the players in `affects` (you | opponents | each; default you). Rules: hexproof, cant_attack, no_max_hand_size, prevent_all_damage, cant_lose_for_life, cant_sacrifice. `cant_sacrifice` takes a `filter` of the permanents that can't be sacrificed.

Rules: CR 702.11c, CR 115.4, CR 508.1c, CR 402.2, CR 514.1, CR 615.1, CR 615.1a, CR 704.5a, CR 104.3b, CR 701.21a, CR 614.17b, CR 604.1, CR 611.3a

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `rule` | hexproof | cant_attack | no_max_hand_size | prevent_all_damage | cant_lose_for_life | cant_sacrifice |
| `affects` | you | opponents | each |
| `filter` | permanent filter (cant_sacrifice only) |

```json
{
  "player_rule": {
    "rule": "cant_sacrifice",
    "filter": {
      "permanent": {
        "token": true,
        "subtypes": [
          "treasure"
        ]
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## spell

The spell ability of an instant or sorcery: its targets are chosen while casting and its effects happen in order when it resolves. If every target is illegal on resolution, it doesn't resolve.

Rules: CR 113.3a, CR 601.2c, CR 608.2b, CR 608.2c

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `targets` | list of target filters |
| `effects` | list of effects |

```json
{
  "spell": {
    "targets": [
      "any_target"
    ],
    "effects": [
      {
        "deal_damage": {
          "amount": 3,
          "to": {
            "target": 0
          }
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## static

While its source is on the battlefield, every matching permanent gets `pump` and/or the `keywords`. `affects` is {"each": filter, "controller": you|opponent|any, "other": true} (relative to the source's controller), or "attached": the permanent the source is attached to ("equipped/enchanted creature").

Rules: CR 604.1, CR 611.3a, CR 613.1f, CR 613.4c, CR 301.5f, CR 303.4m

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `affects` | {"each": filter, "controller": ..., "other": bool} or "attached" |
| `pump` | {"power": n, "toughness": n} |
| `keywords` | list of keywords |

```json
{
  "static": {
    "affects": {
      "each": "creature",
      "controller": "you"
    },
    "pump": {
      "power": 1,
      "toughness": 1
    }
  }
}
```

## station_symbol

While this permanent has at least `at` charge counters it has `keywords` and `abilities`; with `power`/`toughness` it is also a creature with that base power and toughness (layers 4 and 7b).

Rules: CR 722.2a, CR 722.2b, CR 722.2c, CR 613.1d, CR 613.4b

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `at` | integer >= 1 (the N of {N+}) |
| `power` | integer |
| `toughness` | integer |
| `keywords` | list of keywords |
| `abilities` | list of abilities |

```json
{
  "station_symbol": {
    "at": 6,
    "power": 3,
    "toughness": 4,
    "keywords": [
      "flying"
    ]
  }
}
```

## token_replacement

If tokens would be created under this permanent's controller's control, that many `token` tokens are created instead (tapped or attacking if the originals would be). `token` is a predefined token name or inline card data.

Rules: CR 614.1a, CR 614.16, CR 111.1, CR 616.1

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `token` | "Treasure" | "Clue" | "Food" | {card data} |

```json
{
  "token_replacement": {
    "token": {
      "name": "Illusion",
      "types": [
        "artifact",
        "creature"
      ],
      "subtypes": [
        "illusion"
      ],
      "power": 3,
      "toughness": 3
    }
  }
}
```

## triggered

A triggered ability: when its trigger condition happens, it is put on the stack the next time a player would receive priority (in APNAP order), with targets chosen then.

Rules: CR 603.2, CR 603.3, CR 603.3b, CR 603.3d

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `when` | a trigger condition, e.g. {"enters": {}} |
| `targets` | list of target filters |
| `effects` | list of effects |

```json
{
  "triggered": {
    "when": {
      "enters": {}
    },
    "effects": [
      {
        "draw": {
          "amount": 1
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```
